purpose: Surface everything that would make Snapback better. Phase 1 produces findings, diaries, and a gap ledger — no backend ranking, no composite, no win/lose claims.
webSweepOrderRationale: Ascending ambition, chosen for learning, not fairness — early cheap arms shake out harness and packaging findings before the deep arms spend budget on them. Phase 1 has no randomized provider ordering; atomic rounds are a Phase 2 control.

snapbackRevision.rationale: Phase 1 does not freeze a Snapback revision — that is Phase 2's control (LLP 0137, G0). The revision moves as fixes land between arms; every arm's diary and capsule record the exact public package versions the arm ran against, so arms are honest but not rank-comparable by design.

rules: No Snapback checkout, no repository-relative imports, no knowledge unavailable to a public npm user.
Every place the builder is forced to break this posture is itself a finding.

timedBudgets.note: LLP 0102's ceilings are recorded and act as circuit breakers, but exceeding one is a finding to file (with what consumed the time), not a score to protect. A blocked arm records its blocker and moves on. Probes are timeboxed at the deep-arm ceiling.

gates.g0: sweep freeze — this artifact tree and its digest
gates.g1: public @expo/snapback-* package consumption qualification; no diaried Snapback arm starts before it passes; failure returns to LLP 0041/0115 CV-1
gates.g2: fair target access — prefer fresh isolated targets; shared hosted targets follow LLP 0102's namespace, baseline, scoped-cleanup, and confidence rules; missing hosted access is an explicit GAP finding, never an invented local equivalent
gates.g3: platform honesty — Expo arms only after the recommended React Native path and required build mode are pinned; Exact only against LLP 0064 profiles and receipt rules

gapLedgerDimensions: assets, text search, vector retrieval, and notifications
diagnostics, documentation, agent usability, and ecosystem escape hatches

deferred.phase2Championship: preserved in LLP 0137 (Phase 2 section); blocked on the dry-well trigger; its own G0 freezes the Snapback revision, atomic rounds, randomized provider order, and scoring
